lines.zh: 我不走路，我只是漂过去。
lines.en: I do not walk; I simply drift.
My feet hover an inch above the ground.
Scorched marks follow wherever I drift.
Wind passes through me. I feel no cold.
I drift along the wall, avoiding light.
Each step sheds a little more ash.
My shape wavers in the damp air.
I pass a torch and its flame bends.
I knew this road before the burning.
My hem brushes the blades of grass.
I drift along the wall, never touching the floor.
A trail of cold prints stays behind.

lines.zh: 我数着自己还剩几缕烟。
lines.en: I count the wisps of smoke I still have.

lines.zh: 那瓶灵药的味道还留在我身上。
lines.en: The potion's scent still clings to me.

lines.zh: 我试着把手握成拳，握不住。
lines.en: I try to make a fist. It will not close.
I am half flame, half ash.
Is someone speaking my name?

lines.zh: 我对着水面看，看不清自己。
lines.en: I look into the water and see nothing.
The burning feeling has mostly faded.
I remember that I once screamed.
My fingers pass through the stone.
This body was given by medicine.

lines.zh: 没有脚，我悬着，等风推我。
lines.en: No feet. I hang here and let the wind push me.

lines.zh: 我坐着，其实并没有坐下。
lines.en: I sit, though I never really sit.

lines.zh: 火是我穿过的一件旧衣。
lines.en: Fire is an old garment I wore.

lines.zh: 我哼一支没人听过的调子。
lines.en: I hum a tune nobody else knows.

lines.zh: 灰落下来，穿过我，落在地上。
lines.en: Ash falls through me and lands on the ground.

lines.zh: 我又想起焦灼时的那阵疼。
lines.en: I recall again the ache of being scorched.

lines.zh: 你身上还有热气，真暖和。
lines.en: You still have warmth. It is pleasant.

lines.zh: 你看上去不像来烧我的。
lines.en: You do not look like you came to burn me.
I know that look. Do not be afraid.

lines.zh: 你手里的瓶子，是灵药吗。
lines.en: Is the bottle in your hand a potion?

lines.zh: 你站得太近，会被我冻着。
lines.en: Standing that close, I will chill you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I can see your breath clearly.
Only living eyes hold that light.

lines.zh: 你也闻过烧焦的味道吗。
lines.en: Have you smelled burning flesh too?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是怕你其实是灰。
lines.en: I stare to check you are not ash.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上了。
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen on me.
Do not reach out. It will sting.
Your footsteps fall so heavily.

lines.zh: 我想问你怎么还能活着。
lines.en: I want to ask how you still live.

lines.zh: 你的脸让我想起某个人。
lines.en: Your face reminds me of someone.
I split open, then closed again.

lines.zh: 疼是记得的，形体不记得。
lines.en: Pain remembers; my shape does not.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打薄了不少。
lines.en: That blow thinned me out.
My edges are beginning to fray.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方冒出烟来。
lines.en: Smoke rises where you struck.
I retreat; I fear scattering again.
The potion let me feel pain. Ironic.
Stop. I will remember this a long time.
One of my fingers is shorter now.
This wound is lighter than the burning.
That potion. Give it to me.
I smell the sweetness of healing.
A little fire, and I will calm.
Raise the lantern. Let me look.
I know the taste of soul sand well.
Not water. Water would scatter me.

lines.zh: 这块焦木让我想起从前。
lines.en: This charred wood reminds me of before.
I reach out, but I cannot touch it.
Could you leave that little light?

lines.zh: 灵药喝完，我会变成什么。
lines.en: After the potion, what will I become?

lines.zh: 你穿过我，打了一个寒颤。
lines.en: You passed through me and shivered.
I take no space, yet you feel cold.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我边缘会散。
lines.en: Not so close; my edges fray.
You bumped into a cloud of cold mist.
I cannot feel your hand.

lines.zh: 我的形体被你撞歪了一下。
lines.en: Your bump skewed my shape a little.
I pull back so I will not chill you.
Your warmth makes me flicker.
Bump me again; I am counting.
That is not pain, only confusion.
Can something like me still have a mate?

lines.zh: 你的手是热的，我的手是空的。
lines.en: Your hand is warm; mine is empty.
A stretch of fire lies between us.

lines.zh: 我还记得被抱住的感觉。
lines.en: I still remember what an embrace felt like.
Do not love me. I will come apart.
The potion did not leave me that.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会是什么形状。
lines.en: What shape would our children take?

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我的烟就偏向你。
lines.en: When you near, my smoke leans toward you.

lines.zh: 我只想要一个不躲我的人。
lines.en: I only want someone who will not flinch.
Cold and heat do not make a pair.

lines.zh: 我伸手去拿，手指穿过去了。
lines.en: I reach for it; my fingers pass through.

lines.zh: 东西落进我怀里，又掉下去。
lines.en: It settles in my arms, then falls through.
I hold it up with smoke, barely.

lines.zh: 这块石头有温度，我喜欢。
lines.en: This stone holds warmth. I like it.
I bury it in the ash to keep it.
Do not have me carry it; I am unsteady.
It cools slowly in my hold.

lines.zh: 我捡起来又放下，重复三次。
lines.en: I pick it up and drop it three times.

lines.zh: 这个瓶子的形状我认得。
lines.en: I recognize the shape of this bottle.

lines.zh: 我把东西放在灵药旁边。
lines.en: I set the thing beside the potion.
Something over there is giving off heat.
I catch the breath of something living.
It walked through ash and left prints.
That shadow has gone still.

lines.zh: 有人又点了火，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Someone lit a fire again. I dislike it.
It carries the smell of potion.

lines.zh: 我身上的火不是给人取暖的。
lines.en: The fire on me isn't for warming you.

lines.zh: 前面那个，是活的还是灰。
lines.en: Is that one ahead alive, or ash?
My smoke begins leaning that way.
I have chosen this one. Slow and sure.
It holds the fire up high.

lines.zh: 它让我想起烧我的那一晚。
lines.en: It reminds me of the night I burned.

lines.zh: 我飘到它背后，不带一点声音。
lines.en: I drift behind it without a sound.
The cold arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 我的手指对着它的后颈。
lines.en: My fingers point at its nape.

lines.zh: 它呼出的白气越来越短。
lines.en: Its white breath grows shorter and shorter.

lines.zh: 我烧过的东西都化成了灰。
lines.en: Everything I burn turns to ash.

lines.zh: 等它把火放下的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait until it sets the fire down.
My shape has flattened against the wall.
Its shadow is already mine.
One more step and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 心跳声一近，我的火就旺。
lines.en: As the heartbeat nears, my flame swells.
Don't turn. Turning would be perfect.
This bite must land on the soul.

lines.zh: 我张开的不是嘴，是缺口。
lines.en: What I open is not a mouth, but a gap.

lines.zh: 我碰它，它的热气就少一分。
lines.en: I touch it; its warmth drops a notch.

lines.zh: 冷从我手上爬进它的骨头。
lines.en: Cold climbs from my hand into its bones.

lines.zh: 它喊了一声，声音断在半路。
lines.en: It cries out, and the cry cuts off.
What I grab is not flesh but life.

lines.zh: 我的指尖烧着冷冷的火。
lines.en: Cold fire burns at my fingertips.

lines.zh: 它倒下时，我看见它的魂。
lines.en: When it falls, I see its soul.
This swipe leaves five ashen marks.

lines.zh: 我吸一口气，它就更淡了。
lines.en: I inhale, and it grows fainter.
Does it hurt? I hurt like this once.
Do not blame me. I am only hungry.

lines.zh: 灵药烧尽的那一刻，我成形了。
lines.en: The potion burned out, and I took shape.

lines.zh: 我从一堆焦灰里站起来。
lines.en: I stand up out of a heap of ash.
The one I was ran from fire.
The cure was harder to bear than the burn.
I open my eyes. The world is grey.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是我原来的。
lines.en: This body is not the one I had.

lines.zh: 附近有人点了火，我感觉到了。
lines.en: Someone lit a fire nearby. I felt it.
My first breath comes out cold.
The burning stopped, but I did not return.

lines.zh: 我叫什么，一时想不起来。
lines.en: What my name was, I cannot recall.
I take my first step out of smoke.

lines.zh: 灵药的味道还留在喉咙里。
lines.en: The potion's taste stays in my throat.

lines.zh: 这地方太亮了，我眯起眼。
lines.en: This place is too bright; I squint.
I came back, but not all of me.
Fire again. I know it well.
I fell and scattered into smoke.
Water pours through me, and it stings.
The blast blew me thin.
The arrow passed through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 这法术把我和灵药一起搅。
lines.en: This spell stirs me and the potion together.
I am fading. I need some warmth.

lines.zh: 雷光把我照得无处可藏。
lines.en: The lightning left me nowhere to hide.
Even smoke will not stay here.
